name: Replacement Phial
objectiveText: Bring a Mana Potion , Coal , and Sweet Nectar to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to get a replacement for Talvash's Phial of Scrying . Mana Potion  ( 1 ) Coal  ( 1 ) Sweet Nectar  ( 1 )

comments.body:
[s]Shown by Questie, but not available in classic :L[/s]

Turns out. Questie is showing this as available too early. You need to complete some prequests first to receive this.

This quest does not provide any reward or experience. When you start [quest=2200] you are given 1 [item=7667]. You use this item to communicate with [npc=6826]. This quests only exist in case you lose the phial.
